title: Mid-Semester Examination Schedule Published
author: Examination Cell
description: The mid-semester examination timetable for Semester 3 Computer Engineering has been officially published. Check the portal timetable section for room allocations.

title: CHARUSAT National Hackathon 2026 Announcement
author: CSPIT CE Department
description: Annual 36-hour National Hackathon will be held on December 5-6, 2026 at CHARUSAT Central Campus. Cash prize pool of INR 2,50,000 for winning teams.

title: Practical Lab Submission Deadline (Practicals 1 to 6)
author: Prof. H. Patel (ITUE203 Faculty)
description: All Semester 3 CE students must finalize their WDF practical assignments (HTML, CSS, DOM, Form Validation, Fetch API) before November 10, 2026.

title: Hands-on Workshop on Cloud Native & Kubernetes
author: IEEE Student Branch
description: Two-day technical workshop featuring industry speakers from AWS and Google Cloud. Hands-on experience with Docker, microservices, and cluster management.

title: Campus Recruitment Drive 2026 - Phase 1
author: Training & Placement Cell
description: Over 40 top-tier software companies visiting campus for software engineering roles and summer internships. Register on the placement portal by October 28.

title: University Library Digital Repository Upgraded
author: Chief Librarian
description: Students can now access over 15,000 IEEE, ACM, and Springer journals from both on-campus and off-campus networks via university SSO credentials.

title: Diwali Vacation & Academic Schedule Notice
author: Registrar Office
description: The university campus will remain closed for Diwali festivities from November 12 to November 20, 2026. Regular classes will resume on November 21.

title: Remedial Examination Form Submission Window
author: Academic Section
description: Eligible students must submit remedial examination application forms and exam fees through online banking before the cutoff date of October 31, 2026.

title: Inter-Departmental Cricket Tournament (Spoural 2026)
author: Sports Committee
description: Annual university sports tournament Spoural 2026 cricket tryouts for CSPIT engineering branch teams will start this Saturday at the University Sports Complex.

title: Semester 3 Attendance Shortage Warning Notice
author: Head of Department (CE)
description: Students with attendance lower than 75% in theoretical or laboratory classes must meet their academic counselors immediately to avoid exam debarment.

title: AI & Deep Learning Seminar by Nvidia Expert
author: CSPIT CE Department
description: Keynote session on Generative AI and GPU Accelerated Computing by Dr. S. Rao, Principal AI Scientist at Nvidia. Limited seats in Auditorium 2.

title: Hostel Fee Payment Deadline for Even Semester
author: Chief Warden Office
description: Resident students must deposit their hostel and mess fee for the upcoming academic term. Receipt copies should be submitted to respective hostel wardens.

title: Final Year Capstone Project Exhibition (InnoTech 2026)
author: Innovation Council
description: Annual innovation showcase presenting 120+ software, IoT, and embedded engineering prototypes developed by final year computer engineering undergraduates.

title: Continuous Internal Assessment (CIA-2) Marks Uploaded
author: Examination Cell
description: Internal test marks for all 3rd semester courses (CSUC201, ITUE203, CSUC202) are uploaded on the student portal. Grievance window open for 48 hours.

title: Open Source Contribution Drive & Git Bootcamp
author: Google Developer Student Club (GDSC)
description: Learn version control, Git branching, pull requests, and contribute to open-source student utility software during this weekend workshop.

title: Bus Service Route Modification for Anand & Vadodara
author: Transport Department
description: Updated bus pickup timings and designated stop routes for commuting day-scholars from Anand, Nadiad, and Vadodara starting Monday.
